_comment: A catalog for UNIT tests, committed so it is identical on every machine.
Why it exists: `config_registry._ssh_control_connection_in_use()` resolves the ACTIVE
CLUSTER'S connection, deliberately, so a cluster supplying `RACK_SSH_HOST` through its
overlay is not refused at startup. The consequence is that any test asserting whether that
setting is required was reading the developer's own `var/store/catalog.json` — and once the
app had been run locally, the active cluster carried a real `ssh_host` and the fault the test
was written to observe silently disappeared. The suite passed or failed by machine.
This cluster declares `exec_mode: ssh` with an EMPTY `ssh_host`, which is the exact state that
makes `RACK_SSH_HOST` genuinely required. Nothing here points at a real host, so no test
depends on anything outside the repository.
Copy it to a tmp path before use (`catalog_from_fixture` in conftest). The store seeds
platforms and tools into whatever file it opens, so pointing at this one directly would have
a test rewrite a tracked fixture.
INTEGRATION tests that verify a real deployment should NOT use this — they are supposed to

1.name: Unit Test Project
1.description: Fixture project. Not a real deployment.
